faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.text: Straight answers for teams exploring AI systems, automation and implementation support.

items.question: What types of businesses do you work with?
items.answer: We work with service firms, product teams and operational businesses looking to automate repeatable work.

items.question: How long does it take to build an AI solution?
items.answer: Most focused builds take two to six weeks depending on complexity and integrations.

items.question: Do I need technical knowledge to get started?
items.answer: No. We guide the strategy, setup and handover in plain language.

items.question: Can you integrate AI into our existing systems?
items.answer: Yes. We design around your current tools where possible.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing support?
items.answer: Yes. Support can include monitoring, refinements and new automation ideas.
